verdict.rationale: Mistral's Usage and limits docs describe an Organization usage dashboard that shows spend per billing period and refer to adjustable "Workspace caps or API limits." That points to first-party spend capping, but the mechanics of setting a cap and what happens when it is hit are not documented. missing for 10: explicit documentation of how to set hard spending caps or budgets, usage/threshold alerts or notifications, behavior when a cap is reached, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps, budgets, or usage alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill

citations.quote: Use it to understand spend, identify heavy usage areas, and decide whether to adjust Workspace caps or API limits.
Use Usage and limits to understand how your Organization consumes Mistral services and which limits apply.
